description: Simulates a multi-file code refactoring session where the agent must understand codebase context, identify dependencies, and apply changes across files while maintaining consistency.

input.scenario: Refactor a Node.js API service to replace a deprecated database driver with a new one

files.name: src/db/connection.js
files.contentTemplate: Uses old_driver.connect() — needs migration to new_driver.createPool()

files.name: src/models/user.js
files.contentTemplate: Import queries and wrap in model methods

files.name: src/models/order.js
files.contentTemplate: Uses raw SQL with old driver syntax

tasks.prompt: Analyze the dependency graph between these files. Which files need to change first?
Refactor src/db/connection.js to use the new driver API
Update all query functions in src/db/queries.js for the new driver
tasks.expectedOutput: Updated queries.js with new driver API calls

tasks.prompt: Update both model files to work with the refactored queries
tasks.expectedOutput: Updated model files with compatible imports

tasks.prompt: Update the test file to mock the new driver instead of the old one
tasks.expectedOutput: Updated test file with new mock setup
